paragraphs.text: Infinity is an artifact type introduced in Marvel's Spider-Man to represent the franchise's Infinity Stones . It is the first subtype to have an alternate Universes Within name - Terminus - that is considered functionally equivalent. Terminus is featured in Through the Omenpaths .
Along with the Stone type, Infinity is used to represent the Infinity Stones of the Marvel universe. The rest of the Infinity Stones will be featured in upcoming Marvel sets.

Each Infinity Stone has a pair of linked abilities. The first of the two allows its controller to harness the stone, giving it the harnessed designation . The second is the stone's ∞ ability (" Infinity ability "), which can only be used or becomes active while the card is harnessed.
When initially previewed, it was ambiguous whether Infinity Stone was a two-word type, like Time Lord . It was quickly clarified that the two were separate types.

In contrast to Stone, Infinity is restricted to use in Marvel sets. The Magic IP equivalent, Terminus, was unveiled in Through the Omenpaths . The Terminus type is not covered in the Comprehensive Rules . Since follow-up Marvel sets were announced to not get an Universe Within equivalent , no new cards with the type are expected to be added.

The Soul Stone Legendary Artifact — Infinity Stone Indestructible : Add . , , Exile a creature you control: Harness The Soul Stone. (Once harnessed, its ∞ ability is active.) ∞ — At the beginning of your upkeep, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.

The Terminus of Return Legendary Artifact — Terminus Stone Indestructible : Add . , , Exile a creature you control: Harness The Terminus of Return. (Once harnessed, its origin ability is active.) Origin — At the beginning of your upkeep, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
